overview: This single-page file consists of a Department of State list-of-papers sheet for File 894A.111, concerning regulations governing foreign residence, trade, and travel in Japanese-ruled Taiwan. It records an August 27, 1941 despatch from Bruner at Taihoku transmitting a copy of a communication to the U.S. Embassy in Tokyo about new regulations empowering the Government-General of Taiwan to control the entry, sojourn, and departure of aliens.

subfiles.summary: This filing-control sheet identifies the subject as regulations governing residence, trade, and travel in Formosa. Its sole entry records an August 27, 1941 despatch from Bruner at Taihoku transmitting a copy of a despatch sent to the embassy in Tokyo. The indexed communication reported new regulations under which the Government-General of Taiwan could control aliens’ entry, sojourn, and departure.

interest: Although the substantive despatch is not present, the index sheet documents the existence, date, origin, destination, and subject of a potentially important wartime report. It points historians to tightened colonial controls over foreign movement in Taiwan shortly before the Pacific War and preserves useful archival routing information for locating related correspondence in Tokyo embassy or Department of State files.
